title: Les Contes; ou, Les nouvelles récréations et joyeux devis
author: Bonaventure Des Périers
edition: P. L. Jacob (Paul Lacroix), ed., with Charles Nodier notice. 19th-c. edition; text is PARTIALLY MODERNIZED — retains -oit imperfect endings (seroit, falloit, avoit dominant) but modernizes accents, ç, u/v distinction, and several period spellings (mesme→même, sçavoir→savoir, iceluy→celui, veue→vue, iustice→justice).
notes: Orthography verdict expected: borderline-period (heavy -oit but many modernized spellings). Flag for Checkpoint 2 review. 129 numbered nouvelles from Nouvelle I to Nouvelle CXXIX. Editor's AVERTISSEMENT and Nodier's notice occupy lines 96-1248 and are excluded. NOTES editorial section starts at line 9512 and is excluded.
